decision: Approve the captured BF candidate for fixture preregistration, subject to the separately required complete native and ordered build/preview/compare/validate/bundle acceptance.

Reviewer authored four current-reference prose corrections in universal_carrier_review, layout_and_wiring_review, radio_module_compatibility and power_module_compatibility with explicit parent authorization. This is not an independent authorship review of that prose.

Optical contracts correctly reflect the new pivot, 8 mm ears/2.7 mm radial wall, 6x2 post, low arm sections, 0.5 mm tray/fixed-ear nominal gap and ordered nut service; print placements change to land the new bounds on the print plane.

Horn contracts and release-status servo prose now specify the near round hole/far slot. OEM identity/preparation, unmeasured physical fit/strength status and all other release uncertainties remain retained.

All 12 main registry categories and their complete membership/order remain exactly equal; no parts, hardware or reserves are silently omitted. The only saved Group order change reorders OpticalFlowModule within the same BatteryEquipmentModule membership; native parents are identical.

Generated object UUIDs/source fingerprints differ as expected. All 169 main and 136 optional visibility changes are false to true between preserved previewed baseline and fresh raw build; this review is of saved geometry/inventory and does not claim completed final display/preview review.
Independent document XML top-level inspection finds only generated dates/UUIDs and status attributes on otherwise empty Meta/Material maps. No unexplained document values changed.

approval_limits: Nominal captured native transition approval only; no claim that the final complete native suite, final report pipeline, Blender or final previews have passed yet.
Native unchanged geometry uses existing typed boundary signatures at 1e-5 mm with bounds/volume gates; this is not a raw BRep byte-identity claim.
Optical cantilever footprint and moment arm increase, and nominal tray clearance reduces to 0.5 mm; actual print fit, rigidity, creep, pointing, adhesive and clamp retention remain unqualified.
Horn 0.2 mm nominal seating gap and 0.1 mm service gap are not guarantees under a generic +/-0.3 mm print tolerance. Source STEP is nominal geometry, not delivered part metrology.
No historical fixture, production source, tests or saved CAD were altered by this transition review. Fixture pin remains the parent agent action after this approval.
